column1: # v2p benchmark truth set - A-to-I RNA editing recoding sites
# The canonical ADAR recoding sites. No competing tool accepts an
# editing table, so this category is unique to v2p.
# Coordinates are DERIVED, not quoted: for each published protein
# change the codon is located in the GENCODE v44 representative
# transcript, and the site is written only if a single A->G in that
# codon reproduces the published substitution and the genome base
# matches the expected strand. See verification_method per row.
